component.name: HyperLink
component.summary: Use your Android phone from your computer

description.p: HyperLink links your Android phone to your Linux computer over your own Wi-Fi. See and control your phone's screen with your mouse and keyboard, get its notifications on your desktop, copy on one device and paste on the other, and browse its files from your file manager.
No account and no cloud: the two devices talk directly, encrypted, and you pair them once by picking the matching code.
A desktop app with in-app pairing, a redesigned phone app that stays linked in the background, low-latency screen sharing with hardware decoding, and many reliability fixes.
Phases 1-11: pairing, video mirroring, input, notifications, clipboard, file access, network resilience, proximity pre-warm, app-state handoff, ambient context agent, and production packaging.
